articles.title: Meghan Markle’s father cut off ankle monitor after child sexual abuse material arrest, DOJ says
articles.summary: Meghan Markle's estranged father, Thomas Markle , cut off his ankle monitor while on house arrest after being charged with having child sexual abuse material, federal authorities said on Tuesday. "Four days ago, a federal judge allowed Mr. Markle to remain out of custody pending trial," Bill Essayli, first assistant U.S. attorney for the Central District of California, said in a statement posted to X . “He was ordered to wear a location monitoring device. He allegedly cut the bracelet off at 1:45 a.m. last night. Release conditions are court orders, not suggestions. We are asking the court to revoke his release and detain him pending trial, and we will continue to prosecute this case to the fullest extent of the law." Markle, 82, appeared in federal court in Tampa on Friday, hours after FBI agents arrested him at his care home. He was charged with one count of possession of child pornography. He arrived at court in a wheelchair and did not enter a plea. A magistrate judge released him on his own recognizance to home detention with electronic monitoring and barred him from traveling outside Florida's Middle District and California's Central District. The judge also ordered him to have no contact with minors and not to use devices that can access the internet, and to undergo a psychiatric evaluation before the case moved forward. According to the Justice Department, Markle was arrested after agents discovered approximately 78 items, including slides, film negatives and books, that contained suspected child sexual abuse material (CSAM) while searching two storage units registered to Markle, at least one of which was in the Los Angeles area. "Mr. Markle is accused of possessing child sexual abuse material, including photographs depicting himself with minor girls," Essayli said in a press release announcing his initial arrest. "These allegations are extremely serious, and we will prosecute Mr. Markle to the fullest extent of federal law." In October 2026, federal law enforcement learned that an individual signed an affidavit regarding the discovery of suspected CSAM among Markle's possessions in the Philippines, according to the press release. Officers then interviewed a separate individual who revealed Markle had rented a storage unit in the Los Angeles area. This led to the discovery of a second storage unit. Both had been rented by Markle since 2008. An external view of the federal courthouse in Tampa where Thomas Markle appeared on Nov. 6. Mike Carlson via Getty Images In a statement, FBI Director Kash Patel said that Markle “allegedly targeted innocent children and sought to steal their innocence through his criminal actions." "This FBI will use every single resource at our disposal to protect innocent kids — any predator who targets children will have zero safe haven in this country or anywhere they try to hide," Patel added. If convicted, Markle could face a statutory maximum sentence of 20 years in federal prison. "This case highlights the importance of the involvement of the public, even if it's a family member or close friend, to be vigilant and speak up if they have information on individuals they suspect may be preying on and exploiting our children," said Patrick Grandy, the assistant director in charge of the FBI's Los Angeles Field Office. In October, it was reported that Markle was under investigation in the Philippines over allegations that he possessed child sexual abuse material. Philippine authorities plan to file their own charges against him as early as Monday, ITV News reported. The Sun first reported that his son, Meghan's half-brother Thomas Markle Jr., told Philippine police that after his father left the country in May, he discovered images of child sexual abuse material among boxes at his father's former home in Cebu. Markle Sr. denied those allegations, telling the Daily Mail on Oct. 23: "It's just a bunch of lies. It's sick." Markle is believed to have returned to the U.S. in May, after his left leg was amputated in the Philippines in December 2025. In October, The Sun reported Markle moved into Maravida Senior Living care home, a facility which specializes in "memory care." Meghan Markle, the Duchess of Sussex, meets volunteer first responders in Bondi Beach, Australia, in April. Jonathan Brady/Pool PA via AP Meghan Markle released a statement following the claims, saying she was "deeply distressed." She also revealed that in 2019 she received a copy of a letter containing "troubling" allegations about him, which had been sent to London's Metropolitan Police. "It made troubling and disturbing allegations against my father and I was given assurances that these were being investigated," she said. British police subsequently said it had not shared the letter with other law enforcement agencies. According to the Sun on Sunday , Meghan was advised that speaking publicly could jeopardize any potential legal case. Addressing her decision to keep Archie and Lilibet away from their grandfather over the past few years, Meghan said that "any distance from my father, and my choice to not allow him to have contact with our children, was for one reason: to protect them." She added: "My sincerest hope is that justice will be fully served and that the priority remains the safety and protection of innocent children." Meghan reportedly wrote to her estranged father in December 2025 to tell him she was aware of child abuse allegations against him and would not allow him to meet his grandchildren. Meghan reportedly told her father the letter would be the last time he heard from her. articles.title: House Republicans choose Ohio's Jim Jordan as their next party leader
articles.summary: By David Morgan WASHINGTON, Nov 10 (Reuters) - House Republicans chose Jim Jordan on Tuesday to lead them in opposition to a Democratic-controlled Congress, according to a person familiar with the matter, putting a combative Donald ‌Trump ally at the forefront of the party’s fight to defend the US president’s agenda during his ‌final two years in office. A secret ballot held behind closed doors elevated the Ohio Republican and House Judiciary Committee chairman to the minority leadership post ​a week after Democrats swept to victory in last Tuesday's midterm elections, winning sizable majorities in both the House and Senate. House Speaker Mike Johnson opted not to stand for the leadership position. Across the Capitol, Senate Republicans met behind closed doors to decide whether to push forward with internal elections that were expected to retain US Senator John Thune, a South Dakota Republican, as the ‌party leader or opt for a delay that ⁠could allow a challenger to emerge. The House and Senate leadership elections will help determine what role Republicans intend to play as the minority party in Congress during the final two years ⁠of Trump's presidency. Democrats will need Republican support to move major initiatives in the 100-member Senate, where the filibuster rule requires 60 votes for most legislation. Their majorities in both chambers also fall well short of the two-thirds votes needed to override presidential vetoes. After the ​midterm ​elections, Thune vowed that Republicans would work with Trump to block "Democrat ​extremism" and work against any attempt by Democrats ‌to unwind Republican achievements including border security and judicial appointments. Jordan, 62, was first elected in 2006 to represent a deeply conservative rural district in northern Ohio and was a founder of the House Freedom Caucus, a group that former Republican Speaker John Boehner labeled "legislative terrorists." Before entering politics, Jordan honed his pugilistic style during a career as a high school and university champion wrestler, and later as a wrestling coach at Ohio State University. That past threatened his political career in 2018 when former ‌students accused him of turning a blind eye to rampant sexual ​abuse of college wrestlers by the wrestling team's doctor, when Jordan was ​an assistant coach. Jordan denied all allegations, and a university ​investigation found no hard evidence that he knew of the abuse. But former wrestlers said ‌the doctor's abuse was well-known and the report itself ​found that students had complained ​about the doctor's voyeurism in front of coaching staff. Jordan has often referred to his wrestling background in terms of his reputation as a fighter in Congress. He is known for his aggressive style of questioning in committee hearings. "I ​look at it like a wrestling match," ‌Jordan told the New York Times in an April 2023 interview, explaining how he prepares for hearings. "I'm ​going to try to get as ready as I can. You can't just wing it." (Reporting by David ​Morgan; Editing by Michael Learmonth, Alistair Bell and Howard Goller) This article originally appeared on Reuters at https://www.yahoo.com/news/articles/week-huge-election-losses-republicans-110711778.html

articles.summary: One of the female University of Mississippi students caught in camera footage outside of a Black student's apartment Friday evening allegedly making racist noises and gestures apologized for her behavior on Tuesday. “To the women I offended and to the Ole Miss community, I sincerely apologize," the student said in a statement released by a representative on her behalf. "Before the incident on November 6, I never met the women involved and was unaware of their race, however, I recognize my actions were insensitive, inappropriate, and deeply harmful." Courtesy Jakiyra Metcalf - PHOTO: Ole Miss University is investigating video appearing to show students making monkey sounds and gestures, allegedly targeting Black students with racist tropes. Two of the three women in the video, which was posted to TikTok, are seen briefly stepping toward the door camera, beating their chests while grunting and cooing like monkeys. The video had been viewed over 12.5 million times as of early Tuesday afternoon. "I would have never intentionally made those noises or gestures toward a person of color," the student said in her statement. "I have apologized to the women and I pray they will forgive me. I can never truly understand the pain I have caused them and it was never my intention. These girls deserve to feel seen and understood and what I did is not a reflection of who I am trying to become." University of Mississippi officials condemn alleged racist taunts in viral doorbell video, launch investigation "[T]he incident is being actively investigated by the appropriate university offices," University of Mississippi Vice Chancellor Shawnboda Mead said in a statement Monday, in part, adding, "our staff have reached out to the students directly impacted to offer support, listen to their concerns, and connect them with available resources. "I understand the seriousness of this situation and remain committed to taking responsibility and learning from this embarrassing ordeal," the student's statement said, adding that she "intends[s] to cooperate fully with the university’s investigation." articles.title: Vance denounces Hegseth impeachment push: ‘This isn’t about Iran’
articles.summary: Vice President JD Vance (Oliver Contreras / AFP via Getty Images) Vice President JD Vance blasted the effort to impeach War Secretary Pete Hegseth as "absurd," accusing lawmakers of engaging in political theater instead of legislating and targeting the Pentagon chief for challenging the military bureaucracy. "Has Pete Hegseth committed impeachable crimes? The question is absurd and the answer is: obviously not," Vance wrote Tuesday on X. "Like so much of Congress, impeachment has become a ridiculous show that stands in for actual policymaking." Vance's defense came as Rep. Thomas Massie, R-Ky., moved to force a House vote on eight articles of impeachment against Hegseth, most of which focus on the Trump administration's military campaign against Iran. The resolution also challenges Hegseth's involvement in military operations in Yemen and Venezuela. Vance argued that lawmakers have other ways to challenge administration policies without resorting to impeachment. "Congress has so many tools for registering its policy disagreements," Vance wrote. "Rather than use them, they're going to try to impeach Pete Hegseth. They did the same to Donald Trump." "Legislation is hard. Impeachments are easy (and ultimately, inconsequential)." The vice president suggested that the impeachment push was driven less by the Iran war than by Hegseth's attempts to reform the Pentagon and shift U.S. military priorities. "The irony is that legislators are most angry at Pete on the issues where he's most correct: repositioning forces away from Europe/Ukraine and reorganizing the general officer corps," Vance wrote. "This isn't about Iran, this is about the fact that Pete took on the bureaucracy at the Pentagon." Hegseth dismissed the impeachment threat Monday following a speech at the Naval War College in Rhode Island. "There's a lot of politically motivated people who may have substantial policy disagreements, but their disagreements are with success," Hegseth told reporters, according to the AP. Hegseth defended Trump's decision to confront Iran over its nuclear ambitions, arguing that military action was necessary despite political opposition. President Donald Trump also defended Hegseth on Sunday. "He's guilty of two things, basically winning two wars," Trump told reporters. "I believe we saved the Middle East and Israel combined." The impeachment push follows major Republican midterm losses that will give Democrats control of Congress in January. Hegseth, who has vowed to remain in the Trump administration, held a rare Pentagon news conference Tuesday to address the impeachment effort. Hegseth denounced the impeachment effort as a "farce" and an affront to American troops on the eve of Veterans Day, while defending the Iran war and other U.S. military operations as lawful and successful. A House vote on Massie's resolution could come as early as midweek. The Associated Press contributed to this report. © 2026 Newsmax. articles.title: A developing nor'easter could bring 1st snow to millions across the East Coast
articles.summary: Winter will make its first cameo in the eastern United States later this week as a storm ushers in the coldest temperatures in six months for tens of millions of people and the first snow for some. 🥶 Get your local forecast and track the storm in the CNN Weather app The storm will become a nor’easter when it reaches the Northeast coast, shaking up a period of relative tranquility in the region and becoming the first notable storm since September’s early season nor’easter . Nearly 200 million people east of the Mississippi will experience their coldest temperatures since spring as a tease of winter plunges south from Canada in the storm’s wake. The storm will develop across the Midwest Wednesday and slowly strengthen as it pushes east. With it, blustery and sloppy conditions are expected from the Midwest to the Mid-Atlantic and into coastal parts of the Northeast later in the week. High elevations in the Interior Northeast are likely to see their first snowfall of fall, and the lake-effect snow machine will also power on for the first time since spring in the Great Lakes. Not every impact is locked in. How much snow and rain will impact the Northeast and New England remains in question with forecast models still disagreeing on the storm’s intensity and speed. Impacts hinge on storm’s speed Wet snow is possible in the mountains of the Interior Northeast southward through the central and southern Appalachians, especially by Thursday night and Friday. Most lower elevations, including the Interstate 95 corridor from Philadelphia to Boston, will just experience a cold rain. Some snow could mix in with rain in the valleys of the Interior Northeast. Snow totals ranging from a dusting to a few inches could coat the highest elevations of northern New England and Upstate New York. Snow is most likely to stick to the ground in the overnight hours when it’s coldest. This most likely outcome could change in two ways, depending on the storm’s speed. A quicker storm would mean less snow that sticks since it would spend less time in the cold air. The impacts would also be over a shorter duration, and most of the rain and any snow would likely be wrapped up by Saturday morning. On the other hand, a slower storm hugging the coast could allow snow to linger through Saturday. That would give it the potential to drop somewhat higher snow totals. Two weather models show a difference in forecast precipitation based on the storm's track. Green indicates rain while purple represent snow with heavier snow outlined in darker purple and pink. - CNN Weather Both storm tracks could generate gusty winds and some coastal flooding in the Northeast but will not be as severe or widespread as they were during September’s nor’easter. Whether fast, slow or somewhere in between, the storm will bring a dose of soggy weather from the Midwest to parts of the Northeast as well as a blast of cold air from the far eastern Plains to the Atlantic coast. Cold is a lock Behind the storm, a brief cold plunge is set in stone for anyone east of the Mississippi River. Many areas will see their coldest weather since last spring as temperatures drop 5 to 15 degrees Fahrenheit below average. Sub-freezing temperatures are expected in parts of the Deep South overnight Friday and Saturday. Forecast morning low temperatures. - CNN Weather For some in the South, the first freeze may arrive right on schedule as many areas, including Atlanta and Birmingham, Alabama, typically experience it during the first half of November. Parts of central Florida, like Orlando, could dip into the 40s for the first time since March. The cold will firmly settle in over the Midwest, from Minnesota to Ohio, preventing temperatures from climbing out of the 40s starting on Thursday and lasting through the weekend. This cold snap won’t have staying power. Above-average temperatures are expected to return next week in much of the nation’s eastern half. The mild temperatures could be preview of what’s to come in a winter dominated by Super El Niño . CNN meteorologists Taylor Ward and Tyler Ory contributed to this report. articles.title: House Oversight panel says DOJ failed Epstein victims and calls for new probe
articles.summary: Annie Farmer, an abuse survivor, talks to reporters at the Donald J. Trump and Jeffrey Epstein Memorial Reading Room in Addison, Texas. Photo by Ian Halperin/UPI Nov. 10 (UPI) -- The House Oversight Committee accused federal authorities Tuesday of repeatedly failing victims of Jeffrey Epstein and Ghislaine Maxwell, calling on the Justice Department to further investigate allegations involving Epstein's associates. The committee released a 137-page report alleging decades of failures by law enforcement, prosecutors and financial institutions that allowed Epstein to continue sexually abusing and trafficking young women and girls. "The federal government has failed the survivors of Jeffrey Epstein and Ghislaine Maxwell's horrific crimes for decades," committee Chairman James Comer, R-Ky., said in a statement . The report urged the Justice Department to interview or reinterview witnesses who may have undisclosed information about Epstein's trafficking operation. Investigators should also examine allegations of criminal activity involving Epstein's associates and provide survivors with unredacted access to their personal investigative records, the committee said. The report criticized a 2007 non-prosecution agreement negotiated under former U.S. Attorney Alexander Acosta, which allowed Epstein to avoid federal charges in exchange for pleading guilty to state offenses in Florida. Committee investigators concluded the agreement, along with Epstein's unusually lenient treatment during his imprisonment, allowed him to continue abusing women for years. The committee also accused financial institutions of overlooking suspicious transactions linked to Epstein despite warning signs of possible trafficking and financial crimes. "Financial institutions possessed substantial information about Epstein's criminal history and repeatedly identified transactions and activities presenting heightened compliance risks," the report said. The committee urged the Treasury Department and the Financial Crimes Enforcement Network to review whether banks are adequately reporting suspicious activity. Investigators also examined Epstein's death in a New York federal jail in August 2019, identifying staffing shortages, inadequate training and failures to follow security procedures. The committee said its findings concluded that Epstein died by suicide. Lawmakers recommended legislation that would prevent confidentiality agreements from silencing sexual abuse survivors, along with stronger oversight of federal prosecutors and reforms to non-prosecution agreements. Maxwell, who was convicted in 2021 of crimes involving the sexual exploitation and trafficking of minors, is serving a 20-year federal prison sentence . articles.title: Inflation data comes in hotter than expected, even as energy inflation fades
articles.summary: Consumer Price Index data for October showed that inflation remains elevated, as costs rose across a wide range of essential goods and services, including food, rent, and medical care. The Consumer Price Index rose 0.4% in October from a month earlier, higher than the 0.3% economists were expecting but below September's 0.6% gain, according to Labor Department data released on Tuesday. "Core" inflation, which strips out volatile food and energy prices, rose 0.3%, coming in ahead of the 0.2% economists were expecting to match September's level. October's report didn't include annual inflation figures because the Bureau of Labor Statistics was unable to publish full October 2025 data due to the government shutdown last year. But many economists estimate that inflation accelerated on a year-over-year basis. Read more: How to protect your savings against inflation Housing costs were a major contributor to October's price increases. Owners' equivalent rent, which measures homeownership costs, rose 0.3%, while rents were up 0.2%. Food costs were up 0.5%, driven by higher meat and dairy prices. Lettuce prices rose 7.3%, and baby food jumped 5.1%. Transportation costs accelerated 0.8% last month, while medical care items were up 0.5% and medical services rose 0.3%. "One hopes inflation starts returning to normal, but that's a hope right now, not a reality," economist Justin Wolfers wrote on X . Sale signs of meat are displayed on a refrigerated case inside a grocery store in Chicago, Thursday, June 25, 2026. (AP Photo/Nam Y. Huh) AP Photo/Nam Y. Huh Rising energy prices weighed heavily on September's report , but October's price increases were less dramatic. Energy costs rose 0.7% last month, down from 5.2% in September. Read more: October inflation breakdown: Cheaper gas, bigger grocery bills "CPI for October is not great," Kevin Gordon, head of macro research and strategy at the Schwab Center for Financial Research, wrote in a post on X . "Inflation breadth still looking poor across goods and services," he wrote in another post, referring to the wide variety of categories in which prices are rising. Tuesday's inflation data is the Federal Reserve's final look at the CPI before it meets Dec. 8-9, although it will get another look at inflation data via its preferred measure, the Personal Consumption Expenditures index, later this month. The hot report, coupled with a labor market that's holding up and even showing signs of accelerating, cemented traders' expectations for a rate hike in December. Traders now see a 15.3% chance of a larger 50 basis point move . Claire Boston is a senior reporter for Yahoo Finance covering housing, mortgages, and home insurance. articles.title: Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez declines to back Schumer in Senate leadership vote
articles.summary: Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez (D-N.Y.) declined to back Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer (D-N.Y.) as he prepares to seek his caucus’s support to become majority leader beginning in January. Asked by reporters outside the Capitol if she would back her home state’s senator for the top spot in the upper chamber given calls for new leadership in the party, Ocasio-Cortez said that would be up to members of the Senate. “I think that this is a sentiment that is seen in a lot of places,” Ocasio-Cortez said. “So how the Senate navigates that, that’s up to their decision.” Schumer, who will turn 76 later this month, has faced skepticism and calls to step down from some younger members of his party. Multiple incoming Senate Democrats — Sens.-elect Adam Hamilton (D-Kan.), Annie Andrews (D-S.C.), Abdul El-Sayed (D-Mich.) and Troy Jackson (D-Maine) — have said they will not back Schumer for majority leader. Still, the leader said he had secured enough support to become Senate leader, something he needs a majority of his caucus to do. After Democrats’ massive victories in the midterms, the party’s now-sizable majority in the upper chamber allows him to win a vote even if some Senate Democrats do not back him. If Schumer runs for reelection in 2028, he would be 84 at the end of his next term. Ocasio-Cortez is seen as a potential challenger to Schumer in the Democratic primary but pivoted when asked if she would take him on, saying Americans do not want to hear about another election. “The last thing that people want to hear from me or any other politician here is about the next election,” Ocasio-Cortez said. “They want to know about the investigations we’re going to be starting, what is the legislation that we’re going to be starting … what we’re going to do with the power that they just gave us.” If she does not challenge Schumer, the progressive Democrat is also seen as a possible presidential candidate in 2028. A political action committee run by progressive activists, called “Ready for AOC,” recently launched in an attempt to draw her into the race. Ocasio-Cortez has been candid that she is considering her options — presidential campaign or primary challenge. “I think that anything is possible at this juncture,” Ocasio-Cortez told ABC News’ “This Week” in August. articles.title: 美联储再次放鹰！今年票委Logan：至少还需加息两次，步伐或将加快
articles.summary: 美联储官员对通胀的担忧情绪明显升温，鹰派立场趋于强化。 今年FOMC轮值票委，达拉斯联储主席Lorie Logan周二表示， 美联储至少还需再加息两次，且冬季推进节奏或将快于今秋。 同日，美联储理事 Christopher Waller呼吁在12月会议上考虑加息50个基点 。与此同时， 美国10月CPI数据超预期 ，核心通胀环比升0.3%，进一步强化了市场对紧缩政策的预期。 受上述表态及通胀数据共同推动，美国国债收益率大幅攀升。两年期美债收益率单日跳涨19个基点至4.74%，创特朗普今年4月宣布关税以来的最大单日涨幅；美元兑所有主要货币全线走强。 市场对鹰派信号作出迅速反应，投资者对美联储未来数月的加息路径预期明显前移，但在12月加息50基点问题上态度审慎。 联邦基金期货数据显示，市场目前定价12月加息25个基点，1月再加息25个基点，4月或再有一次；而此前市场普遍预期的节点为12月与明年3月。 至少再加息两次，节奏或提速 Logan周二在休斯顿出席一场会议时明确表态： "鉴于当前经济前景，我认为联邦公开市场委员会至少还需实施两次各25个基点的加息。" 她同时补充， "这个冬天的加息节奏，有可能快于今秋迄今为止的推进速度" ，但具体路径仍将取决于经济数据和金融条件。 Logan表示，当前货币政策立场仍在为经济提供支撑，并在一定程度上推升通胀压力。今年以来股市强劲上涨、信贷条件仍较宽松，金融市场整体上依然为经济活动提供顺风。 她指出，再加息两次将把联邦基金利率目标区间推至4.25%至4.5%，对经济产生一定程度的温和限制效果。 美联储于10月27日至28日的会议上维持利率不变，此前在9月加息25个基点——这是2023年以来的首次加息，旨在压制已连续逾五年高于2%目标的通胀。9月会议上，多数官员预测今年至少还需再加息一次。 近期，多位美联储官员在公开讲话中重申了这一判断，但倾向于维持渐进节奏。Waller则是其中立场最为强硬的一位，明确提出应在12月会议上考虑加息50个基点。 通胀压力广泛且存在持续风险 Logan明确表达了对通胀前景的担忧。她表示，通胀压力已不仅局限于与能源和人工智能基础设施建设高度相关的商品与服务类别，而是呈现出更广泛的蔓延态势。全球紧张局势加剧供应链扰动，进一步推高价格压力。 她同时对即将于本月晚些时候公布的美联储首选通胀指标——个人消费支出（PCE）价格指数表示警惕，认为10月数据可能呈现与CPI类似的回升走势。 Logan警告称，"通胀持续超出目标水平的时间越长，它被固化为行为惯性的风险就越大。" 她强调，尽管能源及制造业商品的价格压力消退后通胀有望逐步回落，"但更广泛的通胀趋势更有可能持续下去"。 在此背景下，她呼吁尽快实现政策限制性，以在通胀与就业前景之间取得适当平衡。 风险提示及免责条款 市场有风险，投资需谨慎。本文不构成个人投资建议，也未考虑到个别用户特殊的投资目标、财务状况或需要。用户应考虑本文中的任何意见、观点或结论是否符合其特定状况。据此投资，责任自负。

articles.title: EIA预计今年剩余时间布油现货维持100美元/桶，上调今明两年均价预测
articles.summary: 美国能源信息署上调2026年和2027年布伦特原油价格预测，预计全球石油供应紧张局面仍将持续一段时间。与此同时，美国原油产量有望在2027年升至1430万桶/日，创历史新高。 美国能源信息署（EIA）周二发布的11月《短期能源展望》（STEO）显示， 预计2026年布伦特原油现货均价为97美元/桶，高于此前预测的96美元/桶；2027年均价预计为86美元/桶，较此前预测的84美元/桶上调2美元。 在供应端，EIA维持对美国原油产量的预测不变，预计2026年日产量为1390万桶，2027年进一步升至1430万桶，较2026年增长约3%，并创历史新高。 EIA此次上调油价预期，主要反映全球石油库存下降、波斯湾油轮遇袭、航运能力受限以及运输成本上升等因素带来的供应压力。不过，随着中东地区原油生产逐步恢复、全球库存开始重建，EIA仍预计油价将在2027年逐步回落。 截至发稿，周二布伦特原油期货下跌0.7%。 全球供应受扰，EIA上调油价预期 EIA在报告中表示，10月原油价格连续第三个月上涨，全球石油库存下降、波斯湾油轮遇袭以及航运能力受限，共同收紧了石油供应，运输成本上升也进一步推高了原油价格。 EIA预计，在上述因素影响下， 布伦特原油现货价格将在2026年剩余时间维持在每桶100美元附近。 随着中东地区石油生产逐步恢复，全球库存从低位回升，油价将在2027年逐渐回落。 具体来看，EIA预计2027年第二季度布伦特原油现货均价将降至87美元/桶，到第四季度进一步降至77美元/桶。 对于中东供应恢复，EIA预计，除伊朗以外，中东地区大部分原油产量将在2027年年中恢复至冲突前的平均水平。与此同时，替代出口路线和运输方式将帮助缓解供应受限的局面。 不过，EIA也指出，霍尔木兹海峡及替代运输路线上的原油流动仍可能受到中东冲突影响，未来油价短期波动可能高于其预测所反映的水平。 美国原油库存降至多年低位，2027年产量有望创新高 美国国内石油市场同样面临库存压力。 EIA数据显示，截至10月底，美国商业原油库存降至4.10亿桶，为2014年以来历年10月底的最低水平。仅10月一个月，美国商业原油库存就减少1410万桶，主要受到原油进口下降和出口增加的推动。 EIA表示，布伦特原油与美国西得克萨斯中质原油（WTI）之间的价差较大，使美国原油出口在扣除较高运输成本后仍具有相对吸引力，同时降低了进口原油的经济性。 EIA预计，美国原油库存将在2026年最后两个月继续低于五年平均水平。 不过，随着2027年原油净进口增加、美国原油产量创下新高，以及炼厂原油加工量略有下降，美国商业原油库存有望逐步恢复。 产量方面，EIA预计美国原油日产量将从2026年的1390万桶升至2027年的1430万桶，增幅约3%。 这意味着美国原油产量将连续保持在历史高位，并为全球石油供应提供更多支撑。 整体而言，EIA最新预测反映出全球石油市场短期仍受到中东供应和运输受阻的影响，但随着供应逐步恢复、库存重新积累，2027年油价仍面临回落压力。 风险提示及免责条款 市场有风险，投资需谨慎。本文不构成个人投资建议，也未考虑到个别用户特殊的投资目标、财务状况或需要。用户应考虑本文中的任何意见、观点或结论是否符合其特定状况。据此投资，责任自负。

articles.title: CoreWeave陷入困境：股价高点已蒸发65%，盘后强劲财报也难平息市场忧虑
articles.summary: 市场对AI基础设施前景的担忧，已非一份靓丽财报所能消解。 云计算公司CoreWeave将于周二收盘后公布第三季度业绩。但投资者的关注焦点并不在财报数字本身，而在于： 上周期中选举结果令多个州的数据中心建设前景蒙上阴影，管理层将如何回应这一变局。 CoreWeave股价上周重挫15%，自六个月前高点至今已累计下跌65%，期权市场数据显示，财报公布后该股波幅预计约为16%。 数据中心建设阻力、科技巨头资本开支收紧以及公司自身债务压力，三重风险正在同步累积。 微软据报道正收紧对部分项目的监管，并退出其认为风险过高的项目；与此同时，英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋深陷个人丑闻，其领导层地位面临不确定性，而英伟达既是CoreWeave的关键供应商，也是其投资方。 选举结果重击新云，监管环境趋严 上周期中选举结果成为压垮市场情绪的直接导火索。 多地选举结果显示，大量选民明确反对在其社区附近建设数据中心，这使得倾向于对AI基础设施项目持更保守态度的民主党籍州级和地方政府的影响力大幅上升。 以德克萨斯州为例，候任州长Gina Hinojosa已公开呼吁立即暂停数据中心项目审批。CoreWeave随即致函Hinojosa，表达寻求合作的意愿。 选举结果对不同类型科技公司的影响出现明显分化。上周微软、亚马逊和Alphabet等超大规模云服务商（hyperscaler）股价在选举后反弹，而以CoreWeave为代表的"新云计算"（neocloud）公司股价则大幅下挫，Nebius和IREN同样跌势显著。 这一分化折射出两类公司的本质差异：对超大规模云服务商而言，AI资本开支放缓或意味着自由现金流改善；而对于依赖AI高速增长来支撑商业模式的新云计算公司，AI支出和建设放缓则直接威胁其核心业务。 50 Park Investments首席执行官Adam Sarhan表示： "美国选民用选票表明，他们不希望数据中心建在附近。这将使新云计算公司的处境更为艰难，因为它们没有其他收入来源可以弥补AI业务的潜在损失。" 债务模式埋下脆弱隐患，债券价格跌入困境区间 CoreWeave本身的财务结构使其在此轮风险中尤为脆弱。该公司通过借贷融资建设数据中心，这意味着必须维持持续的高速增长才能覆盖债务成本。 选举结束后，CoreWeave债券价格随即下挫，部分债券收益率已突破15%，进入市场通常视为困境债务的区间。 根据彭博汇编的分析师预期数据， CoreWeave第三季度营收增速预计超过160%，但净亏损规模将较上年同期大幅扩大。 公司预计至2029年前仍将持续亏损，且此后每年收入增速均呈下滑态势。 持续亏损意味着CoreWeave按多数估值指标衡量仍显昂贵，尽管目前市销率约为1倍——接近历史最低水平，仅为公司2025年3月上市以来平均市销率的四分之一左右。 Founder ETFs投资组合经理Michael Monaghan表示： "AI支出前景的重要性远超财报本身，因为市场担心期中选举是否意味着AI基础设施建设进入减速周期。" 本轮AI财报季情绪持续承压 CoreWeave面临的困境并非孤例，而是本轮AI财报季整体情绪恶化的缩影。 本轮财报季已出现多起高知名度的"利好出尽"行情：谷歌、Meta、亚马逊和英特尔相继遭遇财报后抛售，就连微软和闪迪的强劲业绩也未能阻止股价下跌。 更深层的问题在于投资者对AI资本回报的质疑持续发酵。在缺乏更明显投资回报的情况下，各方对科技公司大规模AI资本开支的可持续性愈发审慎。 Sarhan直指核心矛盾： "如果AI收入枯竭，这些公司的公允价值几乎肯定低于当前股价。在AI以外，它们的增长将从何而来？如果无法依靠增长来偿还债务，又将如何维持偿债能力？" 他也承认，从短期技术面看，新云计算股已存在超卖迹象，"但面对如此高度的不确定性，很难想象它们能重回过去的估值水平"。 风险提示及免责条款 市场有风险，投资需谨慎。本文不构成个人投资建议，也未考虑到个别用户特殊的投资目标、财务状况或需要。用户应考虑本文中的任何意见、观点或结论是否符合其特定状况。据此投资，责任自负。

articles.summary: 美国10月通胀再度超出市场预期，美债遭遇抛售，收益率全线大幅攀升；美元走强、利率上行预期升温，也令黄金和白银承压。美联储官员接连释放鹰派信号，市场不仅进一步押注12月加息，也开始评估更大幅度加息以及明年进一步收紧货币政策的可能性。 美东时间10日周二，美国CPI公布后，美国国债遭集中抛售，美债价格跳水、收益率加速上行。基准10年期美债收益率在CPI公布后升幅扩大，美联储官员洛根（Lorie Logan）讲话后，美股午盘时段一度升破5.01%，日内升超10个基点，对美联储政策利率预期更敏感的2年期美债收益率升幅更大，美股午盘曾升破4.77%，日内升超20个基点，势将创去年4月以来最大单日升幅。 贵金属市场同步承压。美国CPI公布后，黄金盘中跌幅扩大。美股午盘时段，纽约黄金期货刷新日低至4020.8美元/盎司，日内跌近2.3%；现货黄金曾跌至4014美元/盎司下方，日内跌近3.1%。白银跌势更为明显，行情显示，美股午盘刷新日低时，纽约期银日内跌近3%，现货白银日内跌超4%。 CPI通胀连月超预期，债市重新定价美联储政策路径 美国劳工统计局周二公布的数据显示，10月CPI环比上涨0.4%，高于市场预期的0.3%，但较9月的0.6%有所放缓；剔除食品和能源价格的核心CPI环比上涨0.3%，同样高于市场预期的0.2%，与9月涨幅持平。这也是核心CPI连续第三个月上涨0.3%。由于去年同期美国联邦政府停摆导致相关数据无法采集，劳工统计局此次没有公布10月CPI同比数据。 CPI数据公布几小时前，市场已经受到美联储理事沃勒（Christopher Waller）的鹰派言论冲击。 沃勒本周二在伦敦发表讲话时表示，即使10月通胀有所改善，他仍倾向于支持美联储12月加息25个基点；但如果核心CPI连续第三个月达到0.3%或更高，就应考虑在12月加息50个基点。他警告称，只加息25个基点可能损害美联储抗通胀的公信力。 实际公布的核心CPI恰好达到沃勒设定的0.3%门槛。数据公布后，市场迅速提高对更大幅度加息的押注。路透报道称，交易员对美联储12月加息50个基点的隐含概率一度升至约13.6%，而数据公布前这一概率接近于零；相比之下，25个基点加息已基本成为市场主流预期。 彭博报道称，通胀数据推动美债遭遇抛售，短期限美债承受的压力尤其明显。货币市场也开始加大对美联储到2027年年中至少再加息两次的押注，并更明显地计入12月一次性加息50个基点的可能性。 高盛资产管理多部门固定收益投资主管Lindsay Rosner表示，如果CPI持续强劲，美联储可能推动更激进的紧缩周期。她的观点反映出市场对通胀持续高企的担忧：即便12月加息已经成为基准预期，后续政策路径仍可能比此前预想的更加鹰派。 今年票委洛根：今冬或需更快加息，联储至少还需两次25基点加息再暂停 CPI公布后，达拉斯联储主席洛根也释放了进一步收紧货币政策的信号。洛根是今年拥有FOMC会议投票权的票委。她周二在达拉斯联储和堪萨斯城联储联合举办的能源会议上表示，按照当前经济和通胀前景，美联储至少还需要实施两次25个基点的加息。 洛根指出，具体加息节奏取决于短期经济和金融环境，今年冬季美联储有可能比今年秋季采取更快的加息步伐。她表示：“今年冬季可能有必要比FOMC今年秋季迄今采取的步伐更快地行动。” 不过，洛根并非主张持续不断地加息。她表示，在完成上述两次加息后，美联储可以暂停行动，评估经济和金融市场的发展，再决定是否需要进一步调整政策。她还强调，通胀长期高于目标，可能逐渐嵌入企业和家庭的行为预期，因此及时采取行动十分重要。 洛根的表态意味着，部分美联储官员正在讨论的不仅是12月是否加息，还包括如何更快地将利率推向温和限制性水平。她与沃勒的讲话前后呼应，令市场对美联储未来数月进一步收紧政策的担忧升温。 美债收益率和美元齐升，金银遭双重压力 美债收益率和美元同步走强，给不生息的贵金属带来压力。一方面，债券收益率上升提高了持有黄金、白银等非生息资产的机会成本；另一方面，美元走强也令以美元计价的贵金属对其他货币持有者更加昂贵。 路透报道称，10月通胀数据高于预期后，黄金价格明显下跌，市场开始评估美联储采取更激进加息行动的可能性。黄金对利率预期变化较为敏感，若市场进一步上调对未来政策利率的预期，贵金属短期仍可能面临压力。 不过，黄金和白银的后续走势并不只取决于美联储政策。美元走势、地缘政治风险、能源价格以及投资者对经济前景的判断，都可能影响贵金属需求。当前市场的关键变化在于，通胀数据和美联储官员的鹰派表态重新强化了利率上行预期，使此前受益于降息预期的贵金属交易面临调整。 风险提示及免责条款 articles.title: 美CPI又超预期、沃勒警告应验！华尔街聚焦12月加息25还是50基点，“新美联储通讯社”：加加停停策略面临考验
articles.summary: 美国10月通胀再度高于预期，令美联储12月加息的市场预期进一步升温，而更大幅度的加息也开始进入讨论范围。 美国劳工统计局（BLS）于11月10日周二公布，10月CPI环比上涨0.4%，低于9月涨幅0.6%，但高于经济学家预期的0.3%；核心CPI环比上涨0.3%、持平9月，高于市场预期的0.2%。这是整体CPI连续第三个月涨幅超出华尔街预期，核心CPI也连续第三个月环比涨0.3%。由于2025年10月美国联邦政府停摆期间未能采集CPI数据，BLS此次未能提供10月CPI同比涨幅。 这份报告恰好触及美联储理事沃勒此前提出的政策门槛。沃勒在CPI公布几小时前表示，如果10月核心CPI环比涨幅达到0.3%或更高，他可能倾向于在12月的美联储货币政策会议上支持加息50个基点。如今这一条件已经满足，市场对12月一次加息50个基点的押注随之升温。 有“新美联储通讯社”之称的记者Nick Timiraos指出，这份通胀报告正在考验美联储此前“拉开加息间隔”、通过分散行动为观察经济数据留出时间的策略。官员面临的选择不仅是12月加息25还是50个基点，还包括是否需要调整后续行动节奏，甚至释放12月和明年1月连续加息的信号。 华尔街人士的反应则呈现出一个共同判断：通胀压力仍然顽固，12月加息的理由进一步增强，但对加息幅度的看法并不一致。部分人士认为，连续三个月核心CPI环比上涨0.3%，意味着美联储难以忽视通胀反弹；也有人认为，50个基点可能过于激进，25个基点仍是更现实的选择。市场真正担心的，已不只是下一次会议的决定，还包括美联储是否会因此延长紧缩周期。 “新美联储通讯社”：核心价格全面走强，联储可释放连续加息信号 Timiraos在华尔街日报的分析中指出，10月通胀表现强劲，正在考验美联储此前将加息行动分散在不同会议之间、留出时间观察经济数据的策略。 他认为，沃勒已经提出一种可能性：如果第三个月的通胀数据仍然偏热，12月加息50个基点就可能进入讨论范围。不过，目前还没有其他美联储官员公开呼应这一主张。 美联储也可以选择另一种方式应对通胀压力：不在单次会议上突然加息50个基点，而是释放12月和明年1月连续加息的信号。Timiraos指出，这可能是调整政策节奏的一种方式。美联储上一次单次加息幅度超过25个基点，还是在2022年。 Timiraos在社交媒体上进一步拆解了核心通胀细节，指出10月核心价格“全面走强”。 具体来看，核心商品价格过去六个月的年化涨幅达到1%，而截至6月的此前一段时间仅为0.1%；剔除住房的核心服务价格10月上涨0.4%，折合年化约4.9%，过去三个月和六个月的年化涨幅分别达到5.5%和3.2%。 他还指出，10月核心CPI未经四舍五入的环比涨幅为0.296%，连续第三个月录得约0.3%的涨幅。核心CPI三个月年化增速升至3.75%，而7月时仅为1.6%。 这些数据表明，通胀压力并非仅仅来自整体能源价格上涨，核心商品和服务价格也在持续走强。对于美联储而言，这使得将通胀视为短期冲击、继续等待价格压力自行消退的难度增加。 沃勒提出50基点选项，市场开始重新评估政策力度 CPI公布前数小时，沃勒在伦敦出席活动时发表了偏鹰派讲话。他表示，美国经济增长强劲，劳动力市场稳定，但通胀仍然过高，美联储需要“尽早而非拖延”进一步收紧货币政策。 沃勒此前支持美联储最近一次会议维持利率不变，理由是此前的政策沟通已经让金融市场提前计入了一定程度的紧缩。他认为，政策调整不一定需要在连续会议上实施，但此前传递的加息信号最终必须兑现，否则市场可能下调加息预期，导致金融条件不合时宜地放松。 对于12月会议，沃勒在CPI公布前已经表示，如果10月核心CPI仍像此前两个月一样环比上涨约0.3%或更高，就可能需要采取更强有力的政策行动。他明确提出，应考虑加息50个基点，并警告如果通胀持续偏高、价格压力正在扩大，仍只加息25个基点可能损害美联储抗通胀的公信力。 10月核心CPI最终恰好达到这一门槛。 Reuters报道，数据公布后，市场对12月加息25个基点的预期已接近板上钉钉，对加息50个基点的押注一度升至约15%。两年期美债收益率大幅攀升，录得2025年4月初以来最大单日涨幅。 不过，Timiraos也提醒，目前尚无其他美联储官员公开呼应沃勒的50基点主张。因此，市场开始讨论更大幅度加息，并不意味着美联储内部已经形成一致意见。 华尔街观点分化：通胀压力难忽视，但50基点并非共识 通胀数据公布后，多位华尔街人士认为，美联储12月加息的理由进一步增强，但对加息幅度以及通胀压力能否持续的判断并不完全一致。 Inflation Insights总裁Omair Sharif表示，最新报告“几乎没有任何内容能够缓解市场对持续通胀风险的担忧”，也没有消除美联储可能需要进一步加息的理由。 他还估算，10月核心PCE价格指数可能上涨0.34%，折合年化涨幅超过4%，高于前一个月。虽然美联储以整体PCE通胀作为2%的政策目标，但核心PCE更能反映潜在通胀趋势。若这一估算得到后续数据验证，将进一步强化美联储继续收紧政策的理由。 Edward Jones高级经济学家James McCann认为，这又是一份令人失望的通胀报告，反映出潜在价格压力可能正在重新积聚。美国经济增长和劳动力市场今年都出现明显加速，核心通胀又开始显露重新加速的迹象，这让美联储面临更大的政策压力。 McCann指出，真正值得担忧的是通胀是否正在稳定在一个更高的水平。他认为，这份报告至少巩固了12月加息25个基点的理由，而更大的争论已经变成美联储是否需要加息50个基点、采取更激进的行动。 Spartan Capital Securities首席市场经济学家Peter Cardillo也认为，12月加息已经基本确定，悬念在于幅度究竟是25还是50个基点。他表示，沃勒实际上已经为半个百分点的加息打开了大门，而最新数据说明通胀仍然是一个问题。 不过，Cardillo也提醒，未来30至40天内情况仍可能发生变化。如果油价回落并逐步传导至消费价格，通胀压力可能有所缓解；但如果油价重新上涨，通胀前景也可能再次恶化。 Northlight Asset Management首席投资官Chris Zaccarelli认为，通胀高于理想水平，使美联储12月加息的可能性进一步增加。不过，尽管市场上已经有人呼吁加息50个基点，他仍预计美联储下个月只会加息25个基点。 Themis Trading联合主管Joe Saluzzi同样认为，核心通胀持续偏高已经证明价格压力具有黏性，25个基点的加息仍是现实选项，但50个基点的行动可能过于激进。他还警告，利率和通胀长期处于高位，将持续给依赖借贷的企业带来压力，进而影响企业盈利和股票估值。 Regan Capital首席投资官Skyler Weinand则表示，最新CPI为美联储12月再次加息铺平了道路，央行不能忽视通胀数据明显回升的事实。他还指出，最新就业报告显示10月就业增长强劲，且此前月份的就业数据获得上修，为美联储继续加息提供了空间。 就业市场仍具韧性，紧缩政策或持续更久 除了通胀本身，劳动力市场仍然保持韧性，也让美联储更有条件将抗通胀放在政策优先位置。 沃勒在周二当天讲话中提到，10月美国失业率降至4.1%，当月新增就业岗位16.5万个，前两个月新增就业人数合计上修8.5万个。尽管从更长周期看，过去六个月和12个月的月均就业增长约为8万人，但整体就业市场仍处于供需大致平衡、没有明显恶化的状态。 这意味着，美联储在面对持续偏高的通胀时，不必像劳动力市场明显疲软时那样顾虑加息对就业的冲击。 Annex Wealth Management首席经济策略师Brian Jacobsen则从价格传导角度指出，核心CPI连续第三个月环比上涨0.3%，说明问题已经不只是整体CPI偏高，能源冲击也可能正在渗透到核心通胀。 他还提到，芝加哥联储主席Austan Goolsbee此前谈及AI需求可能是美联储需要关注的通胀压力来源。随着AI投资和相关基础设施建设扩张，经济活动可能挤占其他领域的资源，并推高部分服务价格。Jacobsen认为，美联储可能越来越关注AI需求对经济资源的挤压，以及水管工、电工等技术工种的用工成本上涨。 Franklin Templeton Institute首席投资策略师Jeff Schulze则警告，最新通胀数据将成为风险资产的阻力。投资者开始计入12月加息50个基点以及之后进一步加息的可能性，短端收益率上升和美元走强都可能压制股票估值。 Federated Hermes固定收益投资策略师Karen Manna也表示，这份报告强化了美联储再次加息的理由，并进一步要求政策制定者保持警惕。投资者真正担心的是，如果通胀持续偏高，美联储可能不得不在2027年很长一段时间内维持限制性货币政策。 综合来看，10月CPI使12月加息进一步接近市场共识，但美联储面临的政策选择已经不再局限于是否加息。沃勒提出的50个基点选项、Timiraos所说的加息间隔策略受到考验，以及其他官员是否会支持加快紧缩节奏，都将成为接下来市场关注的焦点。 风险提示及免责条款 articles.title: MiniMax开源H3 Image：4K图像生成仅10秒，支持多达16张参考图，首周五折优惠
articles.summary: 中国AI公司MiniMax再度加码图像生成赛道。 11月10日周二，MiniMax正式发布并开源新一代图像生成模型H3 Image，主打最高1600万像素（4096×4096）的4K图像生成，官方称最快约10秒即可完成，同时支持精准理解提示词、图像编辑以及最多16张参考图输入。 MiniMax将H3 Image的核心竞争力归纳为速度、画面质量和指令遵循三个方面：在速度上，模型能够在10至20秒内生成4K图像；在画质上，力求摆脱常见的AI生成感，呈现更丰富的细节和更强的真实感；在指令遵循上，官方称其达到开源图像模型中的最强水平，并支持多张参考图协同创作。 与仅开放API调用的闭源模型不同，MiniMax此次同步开放H3 Image模型权重，并将其接入自家API、MiniMax Code和海螺AI平台。发布首周，16MP及以上分辨率图像生成还可享受五折优惠。 4K图像无需超分辨率，直接生成速度吊打主流模型 生成速度是H3 Image此次重点强调的竞争力之一。 目前市面上主流图像生成模型的输出分辨率大多集中在100万至400万像素，生成速度普遍以分钟计，即使较快的模型也需要约50秒。相比之下，H3 Image能够直接生成4096×4096的4K图像，生成时间缩短至10至20秒，官方宣传的最快速度约为10秒。 这意味着，H3 Image不仅将单次生成的像素规模提升至约1600万，也试图大幅压缩高分辨率图像的等待时间。对于需要反复调整构图、配色、光线和细节的设计师及内容创作者而言，生成速度提升能够降低每次试错的时间成本，让创意迭代更加高效。 从技术规格看，H3 Image并非简单地将普通分辨率图片放大至4K，而是能够直接生成约1600万像素的高分辨率图像，无需额外超分辨率处理。 MiniMax在Hugging Face公布的模型说明显示，H3 Image支持多种画面比例，除4096×4096的正方形图片外，还支持5472×3072的16:9横版图片，以及6272×2688的21:9宽屏图片。模型有效生成范围约为400万至2000万像素，官方建议在1600万像素左右获得较好的效果。 速度提升背后，模型采用了蒸馏优化，将采样步骤压缩至6步（Sampling Steps），无需传统的无分类器引导（CFG），以降低高分辨率图像生成的计算开销。 摆脱常见“AI感”，画面细节和真实感成为另一卖点 除了生成速度，MiniMax将画面质量视为H3 Image的另一项核心优势。 MiniMax在官方模型说明中强调，H3 Image能够突破常见AI生成图像的视觉特征，提供更加丰富的画面细节和更强的真实感，使生成图像更接近真实世界的视觉质感。 这不仅关系到图像是否足够逼真，也直接影响模型的应用范围。对于广告、电商、产品设计、游戏美术和商业视觉制作等场景而言，图像模型除了需要生成符合创意要求的画面，还必须能够呈现细腻的材质、自然的光影和可信的场景细节。画面真实感和细节表现的提升，有望让AI生成图像从概念草图、创意素材进一步延伸至更专业的商业创作。 与传统高分辨率生成方案不同，H3 Image能够直接生成约1600万像素的图像，而不是先生成低分辨率图片、再通过超分辨率技术放大。MiniMax希望通过高分辨率原生生成与更短的推理流程兼顾画质和效率。 指令遵循能力号称开源图像模型最强，最多支持16张参考图 在指令遵循方面，MiniMax将H3 Image定位为开源图像模型中指令遵循能力最强的模型，并将其与多参考图输入和图像编辑能力结合。 模型不仅支持根据文字提示直接生成图像，还能接收一张或多张参考图片，根据用户指令对已有图像进行修改。最多16张参考图的输入能力，有助于模型同时理解人物、物体、场景和视觉风格等不同参考信息，在复杂创作中更好地保持主体特征和画面一致性。 例如，在产品广告设计中，用户可以分别上传产品外观、品牌视觉和场景参考图片，再通过文字指令要求模型将不同元素整合到一张新图中；在游戏美术和角色设计中，也可以利用多张参考图控制人物外观、服饰、场景和整体风格。 这种将文生图、图像编辑和多图参考整合在同一模型中的设计，也意味着用户不必频繁切换不同的专业模型或工作流程，便可以完成从初始生成到后续修改的连续创作。 33.1亿参数架构，模型权重同步开放 在模型架构方面，H3 Image基于MiniMax H3多模态模型开发，移除了原有架构中的音频分支，针对图像生成和编辑进行了优化。 根据Hugging Face公布的技术资料，H3 Image采用331亿参数的稠密扩散Transformer（DiT），共有50层，沿用MiniMax H3的Qwen3-VL文本编码器，并结合图像VAE处理参考图片和生成图像。 此次发布的另一项重要内容是开放模型权重。开发者可以通过Hugging Face获取模型，并使用SGLang、vLLM-Omni、Diffusers和ComfyUI等工具进行部署和开发。 不过，开放权重并不意味着普通消费级电脑就能轻松运行完整模型。官方披露的图像生成DiT权重文件约为68.65GB，完整部署还需要加载独立的文本编码器，对显存和计算资源有较高要求。 API、MiniMax Code和海螺AI同步接入，首周高分辨率生成五折 在商业化方面，MiniMax采取开放权重与自有产品平台并行的策略。 H3 Image目前已通过MiniMax API、MiniMax Code和海螺AI提供服务，用户无需自行下载和部署模型，即可体验高分辨率图像生成和编辑功能。发布首周，16MP及以上分辨率的图像生成请求还可享受五折优惠。 从此次发布来看，MiniMax试图同时覆盖开发者和普通创作者：一方面，通过开放模型权重吸引开发者进行本地部署、二次开发和工作流集成；另一方面，通过API及海螺AI等产品推动模型商业化，扩大用户覆盖面。 不过，开放权重也不等于完全不受限制的开源。Hugging Face公布的社区许可证对适用地域、商业使用和模型衍生开发等设置了条件，部分地区及特定商业用途需要另行获得授权。 在AI图像生成竞争日趋激烈的背景下，H3 Image将高分辨率生成速度、画面真实感和复杂指令遵循能力作为主要突破口。能否将这三项技术优势转化为持续的创作者使用需求和API收入，以及开放权重能否带动更广泛的开发者生态，将成为MiniMax接下来值得关注的看点。 风险提示及免责条款 articles.title: 失色的车市“银十”里，合资新能源为何增长69%？
articles.summary: 合资品牌的新能源转型，开始在销量榜上显现成效。 11 月 9 日，乘联分会发布 2026 年 10 月乘用车市场数据，主流合资品牌新能源零售同比增长 69% ，但新能源在其自身销量中的占比仍只有 19.7% 。在全国新能源零售渗透率达到 67.5% 的市场里，合资品牌正在提速，距离完成销量结构调整仍有较大差距。 这轮增长已经有具体的产品支撑。一汽 - 大众 ID.AURA T6 月销超过万辆，广汽丰田铂智 3X 达到近万辆，上汽大众和别克的插混产品也开始贡献销量。合资品牌在家用 SUV 、轿车和 MPV 市场，都拿出了能够参与竞争的新能源车型。 不过，单款产品的突破尚未扭转整体下滑。 10 月主流合资品牌全品类零售仍同比下降 38% ，新能源增加的销量，还不足以填补燃油车收缩留下的缺口。 同比 69% 的增长只是转型的起点。接下来的关键，是把少数车型的突破扩大为持续的产品供给。大众加快本土技术应用，丰田调整研发与采购方式，别克拓展插混产品，都是在争取同一件事，即让新能源真正成为支撑品牌规模的主营业务。 01 新车带来增量 10 月合资新能源的增长，发生在新能源乘用车整体零售同比下降 13.7% 的背景下。对合资品牌而言，这意味着新产品确实争取到了市场需求。 具体到榜单，值得关注的是大众的新车放量，以及丰田、别克已有新能源产品的支撑。 一汽 - 大众 ID.AURA T6 是其中最突出的新面孔。 10 月销量数据显示，其销量达到 1.2 万辆，略高于比亚迪元 PLUS 的 11954 辆。这款 9 月 20 日上市、售价 12.99 万至 16.69 万元的纯电 SUV ，已经进入主流家用电动车的竞争区间。 月销过万的意义，在于合资品牌的新产品能够与成熟自主车型争夺同一批用户。 T6 围绕家用需求安排价格、空间和智能化配置，品牌原有的认知基础才有机会转化为订单。它的开局说明，合资品牌仍有吸引力，前提是产品进入消费者愿意比较的范围。 上汽大众 ID.ERA 5S 则补上了插混轿车的供给。这款今年上市的新车， 10 月销售 7100 辆，同期朗逸为 13891 辆。 上汽大众总经理吴赟 10 月 在一场交流会中 ，专门谈到为什么要做 5S 。过去考虑朗逸的消费者，如今可能想买一辆新能源车。在他看来，上汽大众就得有一款“新能源的朗逸”，让这批人换了动力也有车可选。 对于长期依赖燃油轿车的大众而言，一款新能源家轿达到这一规模，已经能够承接部分用户转向新能源的需求。 别克至境 E7 也在带来增量。这款 4 月上市的插混 SUV ， 10 月销量为 5005 辆。 T6 、 5S 和 E7 三款今年上市的新车，单月合计超过 2.4 万辆。它们在去年同期尚未上市，是观察本轮增长来源的重要线索，产品供给扩张已经形成了可见的销量。 与此同时，合资新能源还有一批销量支柱。广汽丰田铂智 3X 在 10 月销售 9101 辆，与零跑 B10 的 9399 辆、海狮 05EV 的 9033 辆处于相近水平。它在主流纯电 SUV 市场已经具备一定规模，也让丰田的新能源业务有了获取用户的重要产品。 别克 GL8 新能源车系当月销售 4207 辆，位居 MPV 榜第四，高于腾势 D9 的 3801 辆。这个案例与大众的新车不同， GL8 原有的市场认知可以帮助新能源版本触达用户，插混动力则让品牌能够继续参与 MPV 市场的电动化竞争。 一位资深的汽车行业分析师对华尔街见闻 表示 ，以上这些销量较好的车型共同呈现出两条路径。一条是在主流家用市场推出新车，以更贴近市场的价格和配置争取用户。另一条是把已有品牌和车系的客户基础转向新能源。前者扩大产品覆盖，后者提高既有客户在换购时继续留在品牌内的可能性。 分析来看，铂智 3X 、 GL8 新能源体现的是合资品牌已有的销量基础， T6 、 5S 等今年新增车型，则更直接地体现供给扩张。两类产品共同支撑了当月表现，但解释 69% 的同比增长，仍要重点看新车增加了多少销量，以及其他车型的同期变化。 低基数会放大新品带来的增长幅度，上市权益也降低了用户尝试的门槛。从榜单看，本轮回升已有产品基础，持续性则取决于这些车型能否在上市热度过后保持销量，以及后续新车能否接力。合资品牌的突破正在出现，下一步要解决的是如何扩大突破的范围。 02 转型仍需提速 19.7% 的新能源渗透率，意味着主流合资品牌每卖出五辆车，大约只有一辆是新能源。销量结构仍偏向传统动力，使其更容易受到燃油车市场收缩的影响。 10 月主流合资燃油车零售同比下降 46% ，拖累全品类零售下降 38% 。 这也解释了为什么新能源增长 69% ，仍未扭转合资品牌的整体下滑。 按乘联分会公布的 32 万辆总零售量、各类车占比及同比增速粗算， 10 月主流合资品牌新能源车比去年同期多卖约 2.6 万辆，燃油车却少卖约 22 万辆。 增长较快的业务规模偏小，下滑的业务却占据大头。要改变这一局面，合资品牌需要让已有新能源车型 保持销量，同时通过新产品覆盖更多需求。 要补上这道缺口，大众正在把一款车用上的技术推广到更多车型。其 10 月底披露，在中国开发的 CEA 电子电气架构已用于五款本土生产的纯电动车型，计划 2027 年进一步覆盖插混车型。本土研发成果开始应用于更多产品。 多个车型共享技术，有助于分摊研发投入、减少重复开发，并加快功能更新。这为大众持续推出新能源产品提供了基础。接下来，技术投入需要通过定价、配置和市场定位转化为产品竞争力，才能让更多车型获得稳定销量。 丰田的调整集中在开发和采购机制。 11 月 5 日，丰田汽车公司副社长宫崎洋一在财报说明会上表示，在中国，由本地总工程师牵头，把市场反馈更快纳入车型规划、开发和改进。 零部件与技术的选择以竞争力为依据，不受供应商国籍或集团归属限制，并 计划从 2027 年起继续投放中国开发的新能源车。 铂智 3X 就是在这套机制下，由丰田与中国合作伙伴共同开发的。按宫崎洋一的说法，从 2027 年起，丰田计划陆续投放更多在中国开发的新能源车，吸引新客户。 别克则把插混产品从 GL8 所在的 MPV 市场进一步拓展到家用 SUV 。至境 E7 定在 15 万至 20 万元，争取的是一批家里已经有车、换车时想试试新能源的消费者。 9 月 16 日，上汽通用汽车副总经理薛海涛透露，至境 E7 的置换用户中，约六成原先开的是合资车。 合资品牌密集布局主流价位，也有市场规模上的考量。根据乘联分会的零售口径数据， 2026 年 1—9 月， 10 万至 20 万元价位段乘用车的累计市占率为 41.9% 这意味着，这一市场既足够大，也仍有大量传统动力用户。 对合资品牌而言，在这一价位补齐新能源产品，能够同时争取新客户、承接原有客户换购，但价格和配置也必须经得起与自主品牌直接比较。 进入竞争充分的主流市场后，成本效率就更重要。更有竞争力的价格，需要采购、研发和制造共同支持。如果销量主要依靠持续增加优惠，企业和经销商的收益就会承压，后续产品投入也更难形成良性循环。 从大众扩展本土技术、丰田调整开发机制，到别克增加插混产品，合资品牌正在为新能源扩大规模创造条件。 下一阶段，需要观察新能源增加的销量能否逐步弥补传统业务的下滑，以及成本改善能否支持更有竞争力的定价。 这两方面同时推进，新能源增长才能成为合资品牌整体回升的支撑。 风险提示及免责条款 articles.title: 禾赛激光雷达出货增65%，机器人新业务仍在投入期
articles.summary: 禾赛的激光雷达生意赚得更多了，机器人新业务还在花钱。 11月10日，禾赛科技发布2026年三季报。三季度，禾赛交付激光雷达72.97万台，同比增长65.3%。公司营收10.68亿元，同比增长34.3%，低于此前给出的11亿至11.5亿元指引。净利润为8079万元，同比下降68.5%，主要因为上年同期有约1.85亿元的股权投资处置和知识产权转让一次性收益。剔除该一次性收益影响后，净利润同比增长13.7%。 分业务看，激光雷达贡献了9.78亿元收入和1.45亿元经营利润，分别同比增长22.9%和88%。包括机器人执行模组、空间智能平台在内的战略增长业务实现收入9051万元，经营亏损8289万元。两项业务合并后，禾赛三季度经营利润为6258万元，同比下降19.1%。 车载产品仍是禾赛出货的主力。三季度，面向辅助驾驶的激光雷达交付63.81万台，同比增长67.6%。禾赛拿到了五菱车型的主激光雷达定点，同时也获得了凯迪拉克、吉利、长城等车企的高端主雷达项目。 零跑和一家欧洲车企则选用了禾赛的补盲雷达。对供应商而言，五菱这样的项目有机会扩大装车规模，补盲雷达则有机会增加单车配套数量。 同行也在放量。速腾聚创三季度激光雷达销量达到59.56万台，其中辅助驾驶产品售出45.04万台，同比增长200.1%。 随着更多车型采用激光雷达，供应商拿到定点后，还要等车型量产和终端销量兑现。尤其是面向大众市场的项目，订单能留下多少利润，取决于供货价格和量产成本。 禾赛二季报已提到平均售价下降，三季度集团毛利率则由上年同期的42.1%降至41.0%，公司将其主要归因于低毛利产品收入占比上升。 机器人业务的投入已开始带来订单和收入。三季度，禾赛机器人执行模组出货2.34万件，环比增长96.8%，产品从灵巧手模组扩展到全身关节模组。 另一项新业务Kosmo已开始产生收入，并于10月正式发布。它用空间相机采集真实场景，再通过云平台生成三维数据，可用于机器人训练和影视制作。与此同时，禾赛三季度研发费用同比增长27.8%至2.54亿元，公司称增量投入与战略增长业务有关。 禾赛预计四季度营收为11亿至11.5亿元，并维持全年战略增长业务2亿至3亿元的收入指引。接下来，五菱等车型定点何时转入量产，将影响激光雷达主业的增长。机器人模组能否进入更多客户的量产项目、Kosmo能否获得持续付费，则决定新业务的收入能多快覆盖投入。 风险提示及免责条款 市场有风险，投资需谨慎。本文不构成个人投资建议，也未考虑到个别用户特殊的投资目标、财务状况或需要。用户应考虑本文中的任何意见、观点或结论是否符合其特定状况。据此投资，责任自负。
